name: memory_consolidate_prune
description: Executes sleep consolidation using FLOP-weighted L1 adjoint shrinkage to annihilate spurious, weak, or redundant memory edges to strictly 0.0000 and condense near-collinear concept nodes onto shared Riemannian manifolds.

sparsity_lambda.description: L1 shrinkage regularization penalty applied to memory edge weights (default 0.015).

hard_threshold.description: Hard threshold cutoff. Edges with absolute strength below this value are eliminated to exactly 0.0000 (default 0.05).
